name: atom-com
description: Find the right name for your startup, product, or brand: premium domains for sale with prices, availability checks, new name ideas, appraisals, and preliminary trademark screening. Every result links to its listing page on Atom.com.

interface.longDescription:
Atom.com is a curated marketplace of premium, brandable domain names and an accredited registrar. This app helps you research a name for a startup, product, or brand without leaving the conversation.

Ask for name ideas and get premium domains that are actually for sale, with prices. Search the marketplace by concept, industry, or style. Check whether a specific domain is available to register, already registered, or for sale. Generate new names that are checked against live availability. Get an estimated market value with comparable sales, see full listing details, and run a preliminary trademark screen against public USPTO records.

Every result links to its listing page on Atom.com, where purchases are completed. The app is read-only: it never charges, registers, or changes anything in your account.
capabilities: Suggest business names that are premium domains for sale
Search a curated marketplace of brandable domains
Check if a specific domain is available, taken, or for sale
Generate new names checked against live availability
Preliminary trademark screen against USPTO records
defaultPrompt: Help me name my sustainable sneaker brand.

positive.description: Get name ideas for a new business.
positive.prompt: Show me premium domain names for sale for my sustainable sneaker brand.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns name ideas that are premium domains for sale on Atom.com, each with a price and a link to its listing page.

positive.description: Check the registration status of one specific domain.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the domain's status (available, taken, or premium), price if applicable, and similar available alternatives when it is taken.

positive.description: Estimate the market value of a domain.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns an estimated market value and a 0-10 name-quality score with contributing factors and comparable sales, framed as an estimate.

positive.description: Preliminary trademark screen for a brand name.
positive.prompt: Is the brand name Lumora already trademarked?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns preliminary matching USPTO records with mark, status, and owner, plus a clear not-legal-advice disclaimer.

positive.description: Generate invented names checked against availability.
positive.prompt: Invent some made-up domain names for a premium coffee subscription startup that I can register.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns invented candidate names, each marked available to register or listed for sale on Atom.com, with prices where known.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unrelated weather requests.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: Do not perform an unsupported domain transfer.
negative.prompt: Transfer my domain from GoDaddy to another registrar for me.

negative.description: Do not purchase or check out inside ChatGPT.
negative.prompt: Buy nova.ai for me right now with my card.
